exit 0
Wind Waker Multiplayer dev

Play multiplayer:
  <exe> host [name] [--port N]          Host a session (port 25565 unless --port; one process per player)
  <exe> join <host-ip[:port]> [name]    Join a host's session (type the address `host` prints)
  <exe> tui                             Open the terminal menu (no arguments opens the app window)
  <exe> ui [--browser [--port N] [--no-open]] Open the app window (--browser: in your browser)

Patch an ISO:
  <exe> patch <vanilla.iso|.ciso|.rvz> [out.iso]
    Splice the multiplayer mod into your own legitimate copy of Wind Waker (GZLE01)

Lower-level CLIs:
  <exe> server [--port N]               Start headless server (port 25565 unless --port)
  <exe> broadcast-pose [name] [addr]    Stream local Link pose+pos to server
  <exe> puppet-sync [name] [addr]       Receive remotes; render as Link #2 / actor puppets
  <exe> fake-client [name] [addr]       Connect a fake client that walks in circles
  <exe> debug                           Test Dolphin memory access
  <exe> warp <x> <y> <z>                Teleport Link to world coords (uses C warp handler)
  <exe> mods [--json] [--dev] [--mods=a,b] [--no-mod=x] List the mods built into this version
  <exe> version                         Print the version (both players should match)
  <exe> help                            Show this help
